title: Minimum Time Visiting All Points
summary: Given points with integer coordinates on a 2D plane, calculate the minimum time in seconds required to visit all points in the specified order.
statement: Given points with integer coordinates on a 2D plane, calculate the minimum time in seconds required to visit all points in the specified order. You can move vertically, horizontally, or diagonally in one second. You may pass through future points without counting them as visits.
constraints: Move horizontally, vertically, or diagonally by one per second.
Visit points in the given order.
reference_solution:
def minimum_point_visit_time(points):
 return sum(max(abs(x-u),abs(y-v)) for (x,y),(u,v) in zip(points,points[1:]))
hints: For one leg, diagonal moves reduce both coordinate differences simultaneously.
Use min(dx,dy) diagonals then the remaining straight moves.
That total equals max(dx,dy); sum it over consecutive point pairs.
No move can reduce either coordinate gap by more than one, so the maximum gap is also a lower bound.

Five horizontal moves are necessary and sufficient.
